verdict.rationale: Apify ships an official CLI. The probe found it documented at docs.apify.com/cli, the docs describe controlling the platform "from terminal or shell scripts," and the SDK quick-start uses the `apify create` command. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the CLI's command coverage, any AI-native or agent-friendly CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output or agent workflows), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
